
ADD-ARCHITECTURE
Add architecture notes to a feature file using doc strings

USAGE
  fspec add-architecture <file> <notes>

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path
  <notes> (required)
    Architecture notes text

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Add architecture notes
  $ fspec add-architecture spec/features/login.feature "Uses bcrypt for password hashing"
  ✓ Added architecture notes to spec/features/login.feature

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec create-feature
  fspec show-feature

NOTES
  • Notes are added as doc strings (""") after Feature line
  • Use for technical implementation details
